time.description: Time & timezone tools + forex market session hours (WIB, UTC, SGT, etc.)

mongodb.description: MongoDB Atlas query tools — find, count, aggregate, stats

redis.description: Redis Cloud monitor — keys, values, stats, flush

deriv.description: Deriv platform ONLY — real-time data + technical indicators for XAUUSD (Gold), forex pairs (frxEURUSD, frxGBPUSD), and Deriv commodities. NOT for BTC/ETH/crypto exchanges — use TradingView MCP for those.

tradingview.description: TradingView MCP — 30+ tools: screener, multi-timeframe analysis, backtesting, sentiment, Yahoo Finance news (routed via TV_PROXY_BASE when set)

economic-calendar.description: Economic Calendar MCP — real-time calendar: CPI, FOMC, NFP, GDP, PMI, BOJ, BOE, RBA and all major economic events with forecast/actual/previous values and countdown timers. Source: TradingView Economic Calendar API (60-min disk cache).

sentiment.description: Market Sentiment MCP — Long/Short Ratio (all traders + top traders), Open Interest history, and Crypto Fear & Greed Index. Data from Binance Futures API and Alternative.me. Free, no API key required. For crypto assets only (BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT, etc.).
